{{Quote
|Hr = Journal
|Insect formed to imitate a branch, born with sharp, retractable horns atop its head.<hr/>
Its shell gives it the advantage of surprise, but also forces it into a slender, brittle shape that cannot withstand a heavy attack.
}}

<b>Splinterhorns</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are lanky, quadrupedal members of the [[Splinter Tribe]] with bulging eyes and a split-horn head.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Splinterhorns hide as background branches, shaking and popping up once Hornet gets close. They can only walk forwards to close the distance between themselves and Hornet, and are much more aggressive than [[Splinter]]s. Once in range, they use one of two attacks:
* <b>Whirling Jump:</b> Tenses in place and extends its sharp horns before leaping upwards whilst spinning wildly. Getting hit by this attack at any time causes Hornet to be comboed for {{Damage|1+1}}.
* <b>Horn Ram:</b> Extends its horns and charges at Hornet, stopping once she is behind it.

Splinterhorns deal {{Damage|1}} with Horn Ram and upon contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Splinterhorns have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

{{SS Needolin
| columns = 2
|
* Hidey, hidey, here I lay!
* Monster, monster, run away!
* Brother, brother, time to play!
* Sister, sister, your dismay!
}}

== Location ==
Splinterhorns can be found in [[Shellwood]]. One may appear in the room to the top left of the rightmost [[Shellwood]] bench room.
